plan: A painter mage who picks from 9 spells to damage, protect or control at very long range.
aSurveiller: His E (Subject: Torment). He can make you flee, pull you in or root you from range: dodge his projectiles.
contrer: Engage him up close: he is fragile and has few escapes.
Dodge his crowd control spells (E): they are slow.
Get out of his R fast: the zone grows then explodes.
faiblesses: His spells take time to cast.

sorts.P: Two spells on the same target trigger an explosion.
sorts.Q: Damage spells: fire, lightning or lava.
sorts.E: Crowd control spells: fear, pull or root.
sorts.R: Paint that slows, grows then explodes.
